description: A simple, stylized wooden coat rack with a branch-like design. It stands on three legs, providing stability. The design is minimalist, featuring a central pole from which several arms extend upwards and outwards, designed to hold coats, hats, or scarves. The smooth, rounded edges and natural wood tone give it a friendly and approachable appearance. It's a functional piece designed to keep an entryway or room tidy and organized, offering a place to hang items without taking up too much space. The light brown wood color complements various interior design schemes.
